scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev -w @cargoorbit/api" "npm run dev -w @cargoorbit/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cargoorbit/database && npm run build -w @cargoorbit/domain && npm run build -w @cargoorbit/api && npm run build -w @cargoorbit/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cargoorbit/database && npm run build -w @cargoorbit/domain && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
